title: Pointsman decision profile (v1)
description: A named, versioned set of typed questions plus a policy. Question types follow the decision model APIs (Clef, Jev): noul, choice, score. See docs/profile-format.md.

id.description: Stable profile id, used in the URL: POST /v1/decide/{id}.

version.description: Profile version. Increase it on every change; each decision records the version it used.

fallback_models.description: Models to try, in order, when the primary model fails.

input.description: Optional mapping from a raw client payload to the state sent to the model. Without it, the request state is used as is.

path.description: JSONPath into the request payload, for example $.issue.title.

questions.description: The questions sent to the model. A list (not a map) so that form editors can handle it. Empty only for a profile with requires: then rules only, with no model call.

facts.description: Facts to look up for each decision, for example whether the place is inside a flood zone, or whether a pull request changes only documentation. Rules refer to them as facts.<name>.<field>. See docs/profile-format.md#facts.

requires.description: The earlier decisions this profile builds on; rules read them as decisions.<name>.<field>. See docs/decision-chains.md.

profile.description: Id of the profile the decision must come from.

optional.description: The decision may not exist; rules see decisions.<name>.missing. Default false.

visible.description: List the profile and allow calling it through MCP. Default false.

store_state.description: Store the full state with each decision. Default false: only a SHA-256 hash of the state is stored, because the state can hold personal or confidential data.

rules.description: Checked in order; the first rule whose condition is true sets the action.

when.description: Condition on the answers, for example "department.p >= 0.85".

people_check.description: Actions a person checks before they count. Default [review].

people_answers.description: Answers a person may give when resolving a review. Default: the profile's actions without review, plus reject.

bilingualText.description: Text in English and Japanese, so that non-engineers can read the profile.

modelId.description: Model id known to an adapter, for example clef-flash, clef, jev-latest.

name.description: Same rule as question ids in the decision model APIs.

action.description: auto, review, or a custom action name such as cancel.

type.description: inside: inside an area of a layer. nearest: the nearest feature of a layer. detour: extra metres around a closed section (needs a LineString). github_pr: a pull request. github_paths: changed files that match paths. github_checks: required checks on the head commit. github_property: a repository custom property. github_workflows: the GitHub Actions files it changes. github_copilot: Copilot code review on the pull request. github_release: whether the pull request only changes a version (and the changelog). github_bump: whether the pull request only bumps npm dependency versions. coderabbit: CodeRabbit reviews of the pull request. coderabbit_budget: the pull request author's CodeRabbit review budget. coderabbit_queue: the author's pull requests waiting for a CodeRabbit review ahead of this one. coderabbit_spend: the spend on paid CodeRabbit reviews.

at.description: JSONPath into the request state: a GeoJSON Point or LineString (WGS 84) for spatial facts, for example $.location.value; a pull request { repo, number, head } for GitHub facts.

layer.description: Layer id for inside and nearest, configured per deployment (source, licence, attribution).

mode.description: For detour: by car (drive, the default) or on foot (walk).

route.description: For detour: also return the way around (route, an encoded polyline). Default false: the route starts and ends at the section, so it is stored with each decision.

paths.description: For github_paths: the files that count, as globs from the top of the repository (*, ** and ? only), for example docs/**.

items.description: A path glob: * (any characters but /), ** (any folders), ? (one character). Not starting with /, without .. parts, without [ ] { } ! or backslashes.

except.description: For github_paths: files that never count, even when they match paths.

items.description: A path glob: * (any characters but /), ** (any folders), ? (one character). Not starting with /, without .. parts, without [ ] { } ! or backslashes.

property.description: For github_property: the name of a repository custom property.

privileged_triggers.description: For github_workflows: more triggers that run in the base repository's context, added to the defaults.

inert_actions.description: For github_workflows: more actions (owner/repo or owner/*) known not to run workspace content, added to the defaults (actions/checkout, actions/upload-artifact).

items.description: An action as owner/repo, or owner/* for every repository of the owner.

safe_contexts.description: For github_workflows: more github.* paths that are safe in a script (numbers, ids, commit ids), added to the defaults. Exact paths in lower case.

items.description: A github.* path in lower case, for example github.event.pull_request.number.

base_refs.description: For github_workflows: more expressions that name the base in a checkout's ref, added to the defaults (github.sha, github.ref).

items.description: A github.* path in lower case, for example github.event.pull_request.number.

git_actions.description: For github_workflows: actions (owner/repo or owner/*) that need the git credentials of a checkout.

items.description: An action as owner/repo, or owner/* for every repository of the owner.

pin_exempt.description: For github_workflows: actions (owner/repo or owner/*) that need not be pinned to a commit.

items.description: An action as owner/repo, or owner/* for every repository of the owner.

version_files.description: For github_release: the files where a line that sets the version may change (globs), for example package.json or src/version.ts: a key such as version, VERSION or ENGINE_VERSION with the version as its value; in a package.json only its "version" line.

items.description: A path glob: * (any characters but /), ** (any folders), ? (one character). Not starting with /, without .. parts, without [ ] { } ! or backslashes.

version_text_files.description: For github_release: files where any line may carry the version, for docs that name it (globs). Never files that run.

items.description: A path glob: * (any characters but /), ** (any folders), ? (one character). Not starting with /, without .. parts, without [ ] { } ! or backslashes.

changelogs.description: For github_release: changelog files (globs), which may only get lines added; default CHANGELOG.md.

items.description: A path glob: * (any characters but /), ** (any folders), ? (one character). Not starting with /, without .. parts, without [ ] { } ! or backslashes.

not_reviewed.description: For coderabbit and coderabbit_spend: files CodeRabbit does not review (globs, for example **/pnpm-lock.yaml), left out of the billable count Pointsman makes when CodeRabbit stated none.

items.description: A path glob: * (any characters but /), ** (any folders), ? (one character). Not starting with /, without .. parts, without [ ] { } ! or backslashes.

review_actions.description: For coderabbit_budget and coderabbit_queue: decision actions that use a free review (default: review).

waiting.description: For coderabbit_queue: decision actions that mean a pull request waits for a free review (for example wait, queue). A pull request whose latest decision of this profile has one of them waits.

max_age_minutes.description: For coderabbit_queue: a waiting decision older than this many minutes no longer counts (default 120, at most 1440).

pay_actions.description: For coderabbit_spend: decision actions that pay for a review (for example pay). Every logged decision with one of them counts at its price, once per head, until shown otherwise.

usd_per_file.description: For coderabbit_spend: the price per billable file, in US dollars, when CodeRabbit stated no price for the head.

window_hours.description: For coderabbit_spend: the time window of per_window_usd_after, in hours (default 5, at most 24).

pr_hours.description: For coderabbit_spend: how far back per_pr_usd_after counts payments of the pull request, in hours (default 48, at most 168).

payer_apps.description: For coderabbit_spend: GitHub Apps, by id, whose paid review comments count for paid_for_head (besides the author and organization owners and members).

noulQuestion.description: Yes/no question. The model returns the probability of yes.

criteria.description: Optional: what a yes and a no mean.

choiceQuestion.description: Pick one option. The model returns the chosen option and a probability per option.

value.description: Option id: letters, digits, '_', '.', '-' (like question names), so policy conditions can refer to it, e.g. team.probabilities.<value>. Put readable text in description.

scoreQuestion.description: Rate on an ordered rubric. Levels are listed lowest first and indexed from 0.
